Cma grata surprise. The existing reviews do not yet justify what the restaurant actually delivers.

The service was spectacular since the arrival. Already at the entrance we were welcomed with attention and care, and that only improved when we got to the salon. My husband was not feeling well, and we asked the chef for something lighter off the menu. With a lot of sensitivity and professionalism, he prepared a fish in the plate accompanied by rice and puré — simple, delicate and perfect for the moment. A gesture that demonstrates genuine respect for the client.

The environment is beautiful, welcoming, well cared for and conveys comfort. The prices are fair to the standard of the restaurant — it is not cheap, but it is definitely not expensive in view of the quality offered, both in food and service.

It was an experience that marked the trip positively. I'd come back a thousand times and give all the good grades possible. A restaurant that deserves to be better known and appreciated.

reviews.review_text:
We went to the family to celebrate the mother's day. The experience was complete. The dishes of amazing flavors and excellent presentation. A welcoming atmosphere and friendly attention.
Vladimir attended us, with efficiency and good explanations (I asked him for his name at the end of the meal, he never asked to be mentioned)
The prices were reasonable for quality, with the exception of wine per glass where I think they were slightly exceeded.
We all get very happy and looking forward to coming back.

reviews.review_text: Great! A pleasant gastronomic experience!!!! Each dish is a unique experience! I can't decide what my favorite of all was, but the duck pan takes a special place on my back... the best I've had in Lima so far! The exquisite service, Lucas gave us. Lucas was super kind, he detailed the preparation of every dish we chose and his suggestions were the best!
reviews.title: Great gastronomic experience!

reviews.review_text: A unique and unforgettable experience. We were lucky enough to share an incredible moment with the family in this restaurant in Lima, where not only the food was exceptional, but also the service. We would especially like to highlight Vladimir, who was the true host of our experience. He explained to us in detail every dish of the letter and recommended us exactly what to ask to enjoy to the maximum. Thanks to him, we were able to taste the best of the essence of Peru: from fresh ceviches to fish, meat and much more. Undoubtedly, a place we would recommend once and a thousand times.
reviews.title: Unique Gastronomical Experience
